anatomy.flutter: Accordion(items, openIndex, onChanged) builds a Column of Container-bordered rows, each holding a _AccordionTrigger (Press+Surface+Row of label+Icon) and an Unfold-wrapped Padding content box.
anatomy.web: AccordionPrimitive.Root > AccordionItem > AccordionPrimitive.Header > AccordionTrigger (two Icon chevrons swapped via group-aria-expanded) and AccordionPrimitive.Content > inner div, exactly mirroring the Dart slot list.

api.flutter: Accordion only exposes items: List<AccordionItem>{title,content}, openIndex: int?, onChanged: ValueChanged<int?> — one open index or null, no per-item disabled field and no multi-open mode.
api.web: AccordionPrimitive.Root takes type="single"|"multiple", collapsible, defaultValue/value/onValueChange (string or string[]), and AccordionItem takes value + disabled (demoed in the 'A disabled item' example and documented in the API Reference block).

ORIGINAL: The Flutter Accordion widget implements only the single-open, index-keyed case (the doc comment calls this out: keyed by index rather than Radix's string value). It has no equivalent of type="multiple" (several panels open at once, demoed on the web variants section with defaultValue={["fees","limits"]}) and AccordionItem carries no disabled bool at all, so the web's disabled-item example (components/docs/component-docs/accordion/page.tsx lines 150-166) and the disabled:pointer-events-none/opacity-50 styling on AccordionTrigger (components/ui/accordion.tsx line 46) have no Flutter counterpart to stay in parity with.

states.flutter: _AccordionTriggerState tracks only _hovered and _focused locally; Press supplies press/hover/focus plumbing but the widget has no disabled branch and no loading/success/error handling (doc comment marks those n/a for a synchronous disclosure).
states.web: AccordionTrigger's className carries disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 alongside hover:underline and focus-visible:ring-3/border-ring, and the docs States section lists rest/hover/focus-visible/open/disabled explicitly as the full matrix.

disabled.flutter: No disabled path exists in accordion.dart — AccordionItem's only fields are title and content, and _AccordionTrigger has no disabled parameter or branch anywhere in its build method.

interaction.flutter: Press wires Tab focus, Enter/Space activation and a 44px target per its own contract; the doc comment states 'Tab, Enter, Space, a named and expanded button, and a 44px target under a 40.56px row.'
interaction.web: Docs Keyboard section lists Tab/Shift+Tab, Up/Down wrapping between triggers, Home/End, Enter/Space toggling, and native <button disabled> removing disabled items from the Tab sequence.

semantics.flutter: Press is given semanticLabel: widget.title and expanded: widget.expanded, so the platform-level semantics tree reports the label and expanded/collapsed state the way a native toggle button would.
semantics.web: Docs Accessibility section: 'A real <button>, wrapped in an h3-equivalent AccordionPrimitive.Header, with aria-expanded reflecting open state' and the panel is associated to its trigger via Radix's id wiring; chevron is decorative/muted-intent.
